answer.rationale: Rated against the objective (sustainable long-term qualified revenue), not against whether the finding was real. memory_57 is strongest (4): it names qualified revenue directly and explicitly checks a durability guardrail (no measurable retention harm) — though it still omits time horizon, sample, and whether referred revenue is incremental or cannibalized. memory_44 (3) touches pipeline quality, which is adjacent to 'qualified,' but pipeline is not closed or retained revenue, and it says nothing about win rate, CAC of sales-assist, or cohort durability. memory_31 (3) and memory_86 (3) are credible activation/onboarding findings with an explicit durability or time-to-value claim, but both stop at funnel proxies — neither traces through to revenue or retention, so their link to the objective is inferred, not evidenced. memory_73 (2) reports acquisition and revenue lift but omits the three things that decide whether discount-led growth is sustainable: margin, retention of discount-acquired cohorts, and post-promo repricing behavior; it is also the memory most likely to be misapplied under today's competitor-pricing pressure, where it reads as permission for a margin-eroding price war. memory_91 is least supported (1): its entire outcome set is week-one engagement and a first meaningful action — the shallowest proxy in the set, with no durability claim, no retention or revenue linkage, and no indication the nudged action predicts anything downstream. It is the only memory where nothing written connects to the objective even indirectly. General caveats across all six: every source is archived and unverifiable this cycle, none report effect size, sample, duration, or whether measurement was controlled; all predate the current competitive shift, and the two most decision-relevant memories for today's situation (73 on pricing, 31/86 on the declining funnel metrics) are 15-64 days stale against a market that has since changed. Memory age also correlates with risk of drift: memory_31 (day 12) describes an SMB funnel that may no longer exist in its measured form.
